callback.empty: Nothing to sign in with here: this page is where an identity provider sends you back.
callback.linked: Your {{provider}} identity is now linked to your account.

error.invalid_state: The sign-in could not be verified (it was started in another browser, or replayed). Start again.
error.expired_state: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
error.provider_disabled: This sign-in method is not enabled on this instance.
error.token_exchange_failed: The identity provider did not confirm the sign-in.
error.provider_unreachable: The identity provider could not be reached. Try again later.
error.profile_failed: The identity provider did not return a usable profile.
error.identity_in_use: This identity is already linked to another account.
error.provider_error: The identity provider refused the sign-in.
error.missing_code: The identity provider sent no authorization code. Start again.
error.validation_failed: The server refused the tokens it just issued. Start again.
